items.html: Then those seven lower kings descended below, in the world of Beria, completely under the place of Malchut of Atzilut. Their place below the Sefira Bina remained vacant, and in that space between the Sefira Bina and those seven kings, other seven Sefirot emerged, incorporated together in the image of Adam, consisting of male and female. This is ZON, called the eighth king, whose name is Hadar, and the name of his wife is Mehitabel, for Hadar is ZA and Mehitabel is Nukva.
